messages:
Dmitri: heads up — after the passive BMC/BIOS push to eu2 last night a bunch of GPU nodes are stuck in provisioning. serial console is spamming and SOL sessions are timing out. noticed on rack-gpu-38 and rack-gpu-44. anyone else?
Michelle: yup, saw the same on rack-gpu-44 at 03:10. ipmi SOL shows repeated 'oob_serial_overflow' and lots of repeated kernel warnings. networking looks fine (packets in/outs normal).
Raj: was secure-boot toggled in that firmware? we had a toggle step in the new package.
Sara: not secure-boot. i pulled the BMC log and there are flood entries from the host firmware during early init, looks like the BMC console buffer is filling and the SOL channel backpressure isn't working. BMC fw 2.1.7.
Dmitri: confirmed ops-bot rollout=fw-eu2-20260317-2.1.7. rollout concurrency was 50 nodes at once. that might be saturating the OOB management plane.
Oncall BOT: alert: 14/120 GPU nodes provisioning_failed in eu2 (autoscaler churn detected).
Michelle: autoscaler is trying to reprovision so we're paying for retries. cost spike visible on eu2-gpu cluster. can we pause autoscaler for that pool?
Raj: pausing autoscaler will avoid churn but will block jobs. suggestion: throttle OOB rollout concurrency to 4/rack and rollback nodes with obvious console corruption.
Sara: +1 for throttle. runbook OOB-FW-ROLL describes a staged rollback:
```
# quick check
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** sol info
ssh ops@oob-controller "oobctl list --region eu2 | grep provisioning_failed"
# rollback example
oobctl firmware rollback --device $BMC --to-version 2.1.5 --reason "serial overflow"
``` 
Dmitri: i'm starting a soft pause on the eu2 rollout now and kicking manual rollback on 5 worst nodes. ops-bot: set rollout concurrency=4 for fw-eu2-20260317-2.1.7.
ops-bot: done — rollout concurrency updated to 4.
Michelle: manual rollback started for rack-gpu-44 node-7 and node-8. SOL restored on node-7 after rollback, provisioning resumed.
Oncall BOT: status update: provisioning_failed count down to 6. autoscaler throttled by pausing scale-up for eu2-gpu-pool.
Raj: follow-up action: add telemetry for SOL buffer warnings to early-detect BMC serial saturation, and add a preflight to the fw rollout to check SOL throughput.
Sara: logging ticket: PROD-ENG-893 — add SOL buffer metric & OOB health check. assign to eng-infra.
Dmitri: we'll schedule a retro tomorrow with firmware team. short-term: keep concurrency low and do manual rollbacks where needed. thanks all :thumbsup:
Michelle: filing cost note in #finance — quick FYI that the retry churn added ~2.3k USD last night for eu2 GPU autoscaling.
Dmitri: closing this thread, will post the playbook updates and rollback summary in #eng-infra-postmortems later today.
